NO SURPRISES IN THE SCOPE

Know what you are buying.
Before work begins.

Explore proposed price benchmarks alongside our package structure. Final scope, delivery costs, VAT treatment and availability must be confirmed before any offer is made.

Proposed pricing, not a purchasable tariff.

The figures below are exactly 50% of Essential Cyber’s published VAT-inclusive prices checked on 14 November 2026. They are planning benchmarks, not a claim of equivalent scope, a discount on our previous prices or a commitment to supply. Cyber Defender’s VAT status and final customer totals are not yet confirmed.

Important scope difference: the reference monthly plans describe advisory reviews and support, not a 24-hour security operations centre. Their cadence varies; the entry plan lists quarterly check-ins. Do not read these figures as covering monthly penetration tests, unlimited fixes, live monitoring, insurance or certification.

Certification assessment, software licences and external supplier costs require separate confirmation. Minimum terms, cancellation, included time and response arrangements also remain to be agreed. No payment is taken here.

What should be in your quote?

  • Named systems, account and device limits.
  • Delivery owner, timing and customer responsibilities.
  • Deliverables, exclusions and access required.
  • Total in GBP, VAT treatment and payment terms.
  • Any third-party charges or licensing dependencies.
  • Terms for additional work and optional follow-up.

What changes the scope?

More accounts, multiple practitioners, complex integrations or a need for hands-on implementation may require a different scope. Additional work should be approved before it begins.

Advice, remediation, certification, specialist testing and ongoing monitoring are different services. They should never be treated as interchangeable line items.

No automatic subscription.

The one-off review stands alone. Monthly care is a separate, optional choice and never starts automatically. Any recurring arrangement would require its own agreed work, limits, support availability and cancellation terms. Insurance and certification are not included in the planned packages.
